description: Lists the cookies a site sets on its public home page (one anonymous GET, no login) with their Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite flags, and flags the ones missing a flag. Cookies set later, after login or on other pages, are not seen. Choose this tool for: Lists the cookies a site sets on its public home page. Close alternatives on this server: security_cors_misconfig (Checks how a site's home page answers a cross-origin); security_security_headers (Checks the live HTTP response headers of a site's home page). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_cookie_security
title: Lists the cookies a site sets on its public home page
